isaacburston: Arno Isaacburston came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Valentin Jarg and Arno Isaacburston argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
ssprinklez_: Day 4: Viktor Ssprinklez reached R-F2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The signallers took Viktor Ssprinklez in on a busy morning in R-F2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Viktor Ssprinklez tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Viktor Ssprinklez's sleeve at R-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
